cases.name: sum-one-to-five
cases.cs: int sum=0; for(int i=1;i<=5;i++)sum+=i; return sum;

cases.name: zero-iterations
cases.cs: int n=0; for(int i=0;i<0;i++)n++; return n;

cases.name: break-inner-only
cases.cs: int total=0; for(int i=0;i<3;i++){for(int j=0;j<5;j++){if(j==2)break; total++;}} return total;

cases.name: continue-skips
cases.cs: int n=0; for(int i=1;i<=5;i++){if(i==3)continue; n++;} return n;
